tools.name: cyberchef_bake
tools.description: Executes a multi-stage sequential data transformation pipeline ('recipe') on the input string, chaining multiple operations such as Base64, Hex, URL decoding, XOR, ROT13, and hashing in a single turn.

input.description: The raw, encoded, or obfuscated input string to process

recipe.description: Ordered array of recipe steps to execute in sequence

tools.name: cyberchef_magic
tools.description: Performs heuristic forensic analysis on suspicious, unknown, or obfuscated strings to detect encoding formats, hash signatures, ciphers, and compression with confidence scores.

input.description: The unknown or obfuscated string to inspect

tools.name: cyberchef_help
tools.description: Searches the built-in CyberChef operations catalog to find available tools, supported recipe names, and operation capabilities by keyword or category.

query.description: Optional search term to filter operations

tools.name: cyberchef_from_base64
tools.description: Decodes standard RFC 4648 or URL-safe Base64 encoded strings into readable UTF-8 plaintext.

tools.name: cyberchef_to_base64
tools.description: Encodes arbitrary text or byte data into standard RFC 4648 or URL-safe Base64 string representation.

tools.name: cyberchef_from_hex
tools.description: Converts a hexadecimal byte string back into UTF-8 text or raw character data.

tools.name: cyberchef_to_hex
tools.description: Converts UTF-8 text or character data into its hexadecimal byte representation.

input.description: Plaintext string to convert into hex

tools.name: cyberchef_url_decode
tools.description: Decodes percent-encoded URL query strings and path segments into standard UTF-8 characters.

tools.name: cyberchef_url_encode
tools.description: Encodes reserved and unsafe characters in a string into standard percent-encoded format (%XX).

tools.name: cyberchef_rot13
tools.description: Applies the ROT13 substitution cipher or an arbitrary Caesar cipher shift to alphabetic characters.

tools.name: cyberchef_xor
tools.description: Applies a bitwise XOR cipher using a repeating key against the input string.

tools.name: cyberchef_analyse_hash
tools.description: Identifies probable cryptographic hash algorithms for a given digest.

tools.name: cyberchef_sha256
tools.description: Calculates the cryptographic SHA-256 digest of the input string.

tools.name: cyberchef_entropy
tools.description: Calculates representation-calibrated Shannon entropy to determine randomness, encryption, or packing.

tools.name: cyberchef_jwt_decode
tools.description: Decodes and inspects JSON Web Tokens without requiring a secret.

tools.name: cyberchef_defang_url
tools.description: Sanitizes malicious or suspicious URLs into harmless representations.

tools.name: cyberchef_extract_entities
tools.description: Extracts URLs, IP addresses, and email addresses from unstructured logs or payloads.

text.description: Unstructured text to extract entities from
